ModMetaData.name: HSK Algae Cultivation
ModMetaData.author: smokerdl
ModMetaData.description: Experimental RimWorld 1.6 branch. Adds an aquatic crop zone for HSK PlantAlgae and a Water Lily test plant to investigate the vanilla crop selector. Water Lily temporarily reuses an HSK flower texture. SeedsPlease integration is optional. The included 1.5 folder and DLL remain a frozen legacy snapshot.
